ruleDefinitions.name: Msiexec Quiet Installation
ruleDefinitions.description:
Adversaries may abuse msiexec.exe to proxy execution of malicious payloads.
Msiexec.exe is the command-line utility for the Windows Installer and is thus commonly associated with executing installation packages (.msi)

sequences.query: ((process_path = RGX("\\\\msiexec\\\.exe$") OR process_original_file_name = "msiexec\.exe") AND ((process_command_line = RGX(".*\\-i.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/i.*")) OR (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\-package.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/package.*")) OR (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\-a.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/a.*")) OR (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\-j.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/j.*"))) AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\-q.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/q.*"))) AND  NOT ((parent_process_path = RGX("^C\\:\\\\Users\\\\") AND parent_process_path = RGX(".*\\\\AppData\\\\Local\\\\Temp\\\\.*")) OR parent_process_path = RGX("^C\\:\\\\Windows\\\\Temp\\\\") OR (parent_process_path = "C\:\\Windows\\CCM\\Ccm32BitLauncher\.exe" AND (process_integrity_level = "System" OR process_integrity_level = "S\-1\-16\-16384")))
